approvedUseCase.population: USDA/CPER yearling steers in grazing systems
approvedUseCase.scopeNote: The observational case definition does not establish that the current engine represents this population or that its inputs and outputs are jointly observed.

sourcesOfUncertainty.reason: No instrument error, repeatability, or protocol coverage estimates are available for the simulated fields and target population.
Engine constants are illustrative point assumptions and have not been fit to an eligible calibration cohort.
Some public cohorts contain repeated animal observations and can describe within-cohort metric variability, but do not identify the target engine prediction distribution.
Available cohorts do not provide enough independent, compatible clusters across the approved domain to estimate transportable variation.
ADG and DMI diagnostics exist for selected cohorts, but they omit aligned management inputs and the joint outputs required to evaluate the full simulation.
Coverage of the engine input domain and target population is not established; missing inputs cannot be converted into an uncertainty distribution.

outcomes.compatibleIndependentEvidence: Partial component evidence: USDA/CPER temporal holdout and CPER-to-CGRE external transfer; separate Zenodo adult-cow and other cohort diagnostics.
estimableNow: descriptive error and bias for the exact audited cohort and frozen component rule
cluster-bootstrap stability of selected error metrics where animal IDs support it
notEstimableNow: transferable interval coverage across years, farms, regions, or populations
adult-cow prediction uncertainty from yearling cohorts
keyLimitations: engine inputs and management are not jointly aligned with observations
observational ADG is not the same estimand as all engine weight outputs
empirical coverage varied across held-out site/year subsets

outcomes.compatibleIndependentEvidence: Component checks exist in feedlot, hay, and dairy grazing cohorts; these are distinct systems and populations from the approved USDA/CPER case.
estimableNow: descriptive component error and bias for each exact dataset, protocol, and frozen rule
notEstimableNow: forage intake uncertainty in the approved target population
joint intake and weight prediction uncertainty
keyLimitations: some sources have small cluster counts or derived outcomes
DMI results cannot be pooled across domains as one distribution

outcomes.compatibleIndependentEvidence: Some public sources report pasture or vegetation indicators at group, paddock, or remote-sensing level; they are not aligned to the engine's initial stock, daily growth, intake, and paddock transitions.
estimableNow: source-specific descriptive summaries when the reported unit and period are retained
notEstimableNow: daily or paddock-level predictive intervals for engine stock
joint stock and animal outcome uncertainty
keyLimitations: complete aligned time series and management inputs are absent
remote-sensing indicators are not direct stock measurements

outcomes.compatibleIndependentEvidence: No independent dataset is currently identified with comparable per-animal feed quantities, local prices, and cost outcomes aligned to the engine scenario.
estimableNow: deterministic arithmetic under explicitly entered price assumptions
keyLimitations: regional and temporal price variation is not observed by the engine

outcomes.compatibleIndependentEvidence: Weather and stress rules are fixed deterministic transformations; no compatible physiological or production endpoint dataset is paired to these engine outputs.
estimableNow: deterministic sensitivity to the configured weather category
keyLimitations: deterministic sensitivity is not a sampling distribution
weather categories do not establish animal-specific exposure or response

mustFreezeBeforeHoldout: interval construction method and nominal level
evaluationGate.splitPolicy: Keep all observations from an animal in one partition; also hold out farm, year, region, or system when those clusters define intended transfer.
evaluationGate.promotionRule: A prediction interval may be enabled only for the exact outcome and target domain after an independent compatible evaluation supports its stated coverage. Metric bootstrap intervals and deterministic sensitivity ranges do not satisfy this gate.
